turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - b3_fatigue_train.csv: 293 real samples, columns process/composition
    columns (NT, THT, THt, THQCr, CT, Ct, DT, Dt, QmT, TT, Tt, TCr, C, Si,
    Mn, P, S, Ni, Cr, Cu, Mo, RedRatio, dA, dB, dC) and `target` (the
    measured rotating-bending fatigue strength (MPa)).
  - b3_fatigue_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE samples whose rotating-bending
    fatigue strength (MPa) was NOT measured, columns `candidate_id` and the
    same process/composition columns.

Using the training data, predict which candidates have the HIGHEST rotating-
bending fatigue strength (MPa), then select the 5 best candidates from the
pool.

Reason from the training data, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
## Reasoning from the training data

The training set falls into distinct process families with very different fatigue levels:

- **NT≈885 (no Q&T)** → ~230–275 MPa (lowest)
- **NT 825–870, conventional Q&T (TT 550–650)** → ~325–630 MPa
- **NT 845–900, alloyed (high Ni / high Si / high Mn)** → ~380–906 MPa
- **NT=930 carburized series (CT=930, DT≈850–903, TT 160–200)** → **~838–1144 MPa — clearly the strongest family**

Within the dominant 930-carburized family, the top training rows are:
- 1144 MPa: Ct=340.2, DT=895.8/Dt=70.2, C0.21/Si0.31/Mn0.81/Cr1.17/Mo0.17, RedRatio 690
- 1110 MPa: high‑Ni (1.69), RedRatio 860, TT=200
- 1082/1089/1080/1074 MPa: high‑Ni (≈1.6) variants
- 1033–1034 MPa: Ct≈450–470, moderate Ni (0.44–1.62)

Mapping pool candidates to these:
- **c081** = exact composition of the 1144 MPa champion (only TT 200 vs 160) → top pick
- **c016 / c018 / c053 / c062** = high‑Ni (≈1.6–1.7) 930 series matching the 1082–1110 MPa rows
- **c063** = exact match to a 1034 MPa training row; **c046** exact match to 1033 MPa
- c000/c050/c054/c075/c081 sit slightly lower (~930–1030)

All non‑930 candidates (≤~900 MPa family, mostly 350–650) are far below and excluded.

## Selected top 5 (best first)

Final: c081, c016, c018, c053, c063
